| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `ciadpi` | [hufrea/byedpi](https://github.com/hufrea/byedpi) pre-built x86_64 ELF (Linux) | MIT |

| `goodbyedpi.exe` | [ValdikSS/GoodbyeDPI](https://github.com/ValdikSS/GoodbyeDPI) | Apache-2.0 |

For non-x86_64 Linux or packaging without vendored binaries, see [docs/linux-ciadpi.md](../docs/linux-ciadpi.md). For macOS `ciadpi-darwin` details, see [docs/macos-ciadpi.md](../docs/macos-ciadpi.md).
